title: Food Delivery, Fresh from the West Philippine Sea

title: Alipato at Muog
status_detail: Premiered at Cinemalaya 2024; an initial X rating was reduced to R-16 on appeal. No legal streaming, VOD or archive access was found.

quoted_reason.text: The film tends to undermine the faith and confidence of the people in their government and/or duly-constituted authorities.

title: Dear Satan
status_detail: MTRCB upheld a final X rating, barring commercial theatrical release; no legal copy was found.

quoted_reason.text: The Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB) on Thursday upheld its final decision to ban the film “Dear Santa,” originally titled “Dear Satan,” citing the film’s portrayal of “Satan” in a positive light as an attack on fundamental belief of the Catholic and Christian faiths.

notes: The film was renamed Dear Santa, but the MTRCB upheld the X rating. No legal streaming or theatrical release was found. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Ang Mabuhay para sa Masa

quoted_reason.attributed_to: MTRCB, as reported by The Philippine Star

title: Live Show
status_detail: Permanently banned from Philippine theaters in 2001; a legal uncut version is now rentable on Amazon US.

quoted_reason.text: Premises considered, this committee hereby orders the permanent banning of the aforesaid movie and therefore revokes the permit issued by the MTRCB (Movie and Television Review and Classification Board) for its public exhibition.
quoted_reason.attributed_to: Renato Corona, Malacañang appeals committee, quoted by The Philippine Star

where_to_watch.note: US region. The 2001 permanent ban from Philippine theaters remains on record.

notes: The film opened in Philippine theaters in the second week of March 2001 and was permanently banned on 3 April 2001. Amazon lists an uncut 1h47m version for rent/buy; this is a legal US VOD listing, not a lifting of the Philippine ban. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Butakal: Sugapa sa Laman
status_detail: MTRCB recalled the film before its scheduled 1999 release after the Chiong family objected; the Supreme Court later ordered the master copy returned while the prohibition remained.

quoted_reason.text: the subject complaint of petitioners cannot be given due course while the above-mentioned cases are still pending…
quoted_reason.attributed_to: MTRCB Hearing and Adjudication Committee, quoted in the Supreme Court decision

sources.publisher: Lawphil / Supreme Court of the Philippines

notes: The film was scheduled to open on 8 Sept 1999. The MTRCB recalled it after the Chiong family complained that it exploited a pending rape-murder case. In 2007 the Supreme Court ordered the master copy returned but did not lift the prohibition. No legal copy was located. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Orapronobis
status_detail: Brocka's Cannes-premiered film was never given a Philippine theatrical release; no formal lifting of the censors' ban and no legal streaming found.

quoted_reason.text: Lino Brocka’s “Orapronobis” has the unfortunate status of still being haunted by the local censors board’s ban against its “subversive” message, three and a half decades later.

notes: Filed as unavailable rather than banned because no quotable regulator or court decision was located. Asian Movie Pulse reports no formal lifting of the ban and that Brocka lost the court case. An unofficial full-length upload circulates online; it is not linked. MUBI says the film is not currently playing. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Milagro sa Porta Vaga
status_detail: 1982 Julie Vega religious drama; only a production still is known and no archive copy has been located.
notes: Lost-media communities call it lost, and a heritage page says only one production still survives. No archive or historian statement was located, so the record is filed as unavailable, not lost. LMP spells the director's surname Orbenta; IMDb gives Orbeta. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Agent 00

A YouTube upload titled 'Agent 00: For U'r Height Only' circulates; its identity and rights status are unverified, so it is not linked. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Iginuhit ng Tadhana
director: Mar S. Torres, Jose de Villa and Conrado Conde
status_detail: The Board of Censors suspended its 1965 release, then allowed it to resume; no legal copy is currently offered.

quoted_reason.text: Officials of the board said that the board voted to suspend the exhibition of the movie, “Iginuhit ng Tadhana” (Destined by Fate) because its producer failed to submit it for preview by the board en banc or by the entire board.
quoted_reason.attributed_to: Board of Censors officials, quoted by The Manila Times via Video 48

notes: The suspension was temporary; the film resumed its theatrical run and became a campaign asset for Marcos. Full-film uploads circulate online but are not linked. No legal streaming or archive access was found. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Dyesebel
status_detail: A rare 1953 adaptation; ABS-CBN Film Restoration says no copy survives, while a 2005 i-Witness account reports a Dyesebel print in a Thai archive.
notes: ABS-CBN Film Restoration states that no copy survives, while a 2005 i-Witness account reports a Dyesebel print in a Thai archive. The two claims conflict. No copy has been confirmed, catalogued, or made legally accessible, so the film is filed as unavailable rather than lost. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Korea

notes: Wikipedia describes the film as considered lost. No archive or historian statement naming a surviving copy was located. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Darna
status_detail: Long thought lost; a 40-minute, silent, incomplete copy was found in Thailand in 2005.

known_copy.holder: Thai film archive (reported holding; examined by Howie Severino/i-Witness)

notes: The first Darna film. The surviving copy covers only scenes with the villain Valentina and has no audio. No legal streaming, VOD or archive access was found as of 31 Oct 2026.

title: Secreto de Confesión
status_detail: The first Spanish-language Filipino film; all copies were reportedly destroyed in the bombing of Manila in World War II.
notes: Film histories state that all existing copies were lost during the U.S. bombing of Manila. No archive or historian statement naming a surviving copy was located. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Ang Batang Tulisan

last_verified_screening.venue: Fox Theater and Savoy Theater, Manila

title: Tiniente Rosario

notes: The film is considered lost in film histories; no archive or historian statement naming a surviving copy was located. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: Diwata ng Karagatan
status_detail: A 44-minute French-language version was identified at CINEMATEK in 2025; the original Filipino cut is not known to survive.

quoted_reason.text: Since after its last exhibition at Fox Theater in Manila, nothing has been heard of it until the war broke out in 1941. All movies in Manila disappeared with the war. Thankfully, a copy of the film has now been found abroad.
quoted_reason.attributed_to: Nick Deocampo, film historian, quoted by CINEMATEK

known_copy.access: archive holding; access policy not stated; no public streaming

where_to_watch.platform: CINEMATEK archive — holding; access by inquiry
where_to_watch.note: No public streaming or home video release announced. Contact the archive directly; the dossier does not state a public access policy.

notes: The only known surviving copy is a shortened French-language version catalogued as Ligaya, fille des îles. It was deposited at CINEMATEK in 1969 and a safety copy was made in 2003. The original Filipino cut is not known to survive. Discovery recorded 2025.

title: Dalagang Bukid
status_detail: The first Filipino feature; ABS-CBN Film Restoration states that no copy survives on any format.

quoted_reason.text: Dalagang Bukid (1919), Darna (1951), and Dyesebel (1953) are films that no longer exist on any format…

notes: ABS-CBN Film Restoration states that no copy survives on any format. Leo Katigbak of ABS-CBN Film Archives discusses the low survival rate for pre-war Philippine film in a 2026 interview. The film premiered on 12 Sept 1919; IMDb lists 25 Sept 1919. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.

title: La Venganza de Don Silvestre
status_detail: The 1919 sequel to Dalagang Bukid; no copy is known and film histories treat it as lost.
notes: The sequel premiered on 12 Oct 1919, a month after Dalagang Bukid. No archive or historian statement specifically naming a surviving copy of the sequel was located. Availability checked 31 Oct 2026.
